description: Start a bounded video search for a query, platform and region, paid in credits. Returns jobId when admitted; a search answered from the cache returns its result at once (cacheOnly, no jobId). A completed result has videos[] (one normalised row per video on every platform: id, rank, thumbnailUrl, creator handle and followers, postedAt, views, likes, comments, shares, saves, viewsPerDay, engagementRate with its formula, and vsCreatorMedian, which has a ratio only when views are at least 3× the creator's median over at least 10 stored posts) and a summary (median views, top outliers, top views per day, date spread). Null values are unknown; videos[].unknown says why. If videos is null, videosUnavailable says why and the raw result is still complete. Results carry coverage, provider limitations and evidenceNotes. When the credits or plan do not cover it, the result is upgrade_required with a message and upgrade link, and nothing ran; after an upgrade, the same request with the same idempotency key runs it. Poll socialseal_get_video_search for admitted legacy jobs. Concurrent equivalent searches coalesce. No ongoing tracker is created. Rows are videos surfaced for the selected queries at capture time, not search volume or total market demand. Region is the collection market, not verified viewer geography. Views, likes and saves are per-video engagement snapshots, not engagement attributable to the query.

idempotencyKey.description: Generate once per intended search and reuse for retries. Use a new key to refresh results later.

limit.description: Fresh-result limit: TikTok 20, Instagram 30, YouTube/Douyin/XHS 50. Default 20. The price uses this requested scope.

maxCostUsd.description: Optional USD maximum for this search; a higher price is refused with CALLER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

quoteOnly.description: Return the credit price without starting provider work.

region.description: Search collection market; does not establish viewer residence or audience demographics.

strategyRevisionId.description: revisionId of a brand Strategy already returned in this conversation (strategyContext.revisionId). When it is still current, the Strategy is not repeated.

workspaceId.description: Authorized workspace for this search; resolve it before starting.
